notes: Perplexity Agent language models, legacy Sonar chat, and quantized embeddings mirror upstream Perplexity 5.0.20: `PERPLEXITY_API_KEY`, custom base URL and headers, versioned user-agent suffix, callable/language Agent surface plus chat/sonar compatibility and embedding/textEmbedding aliases, `/v1/agent`, `/chat/completions`, and `/v1/embeddings`, text/image/PDF message conversion, JSON schema response format, providerOptions.perplexity passthrough including quantized embedding dimensions and signed/binary base64 decoding with a 512-value preflight limit, citations/images/cost metadata, optional and null streaming delta content, reasoning-token separation from completion tokens with corrected total accounting, Perplexity error schema, and warnings for unsupported topK/stop/seed/custom reasoning while treating provider-default reasoning as a no-op. Perplexity 5.0.1 accepts explicit null values for optional Agent SSE fields without failing the stream, including null content indexes that retain the base text-part ID. The 5.0.0 migration makes `languageModel` and the callable provider use the Agent API; use `chatModel` or `sonarModel` for the legacy Sonar Chat Completions API. ProviderV4 type names, ESM-only packaging, Node 22 engines, optional JS headers config, and workflow serialization helpers are JS-only upstream concerns. The default X-Pplx-Integration header is vercel-ai-sdk; explicit headers override it case-insensitively. The 2026-10-11 pass: Common max effort maps to xhigh; unknown effort warns and is omitted. Embeddings inherit shared dimensions unless a provider override is supplied. The 2026-10-23 pass: Native decisionModel calls /v1/decisions with named Choice/Score/Boolean questions, up to eight inline images, full-precision answers, confidence/score legends, and unsupported-setting warnings.
